meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在本地校验基因组区间数据并规划分析流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组区间研究,需要在校验数据后规划模型运行
copy.tagline_en: Validate genomic interval data locally and plan analysis runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on genomic intervals and need validated, planned analysis runs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 BED 等基因组区间数据的机器学习任务中使用 geniml 的工作方式：校验输入、把 Region2Vec/scEmbed/BEDspace 的流程写成可执行步骤，协助构建共识峰并评估输出。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 BED 等基因组区间数据的机器学习处理，比如训练区段嵌入、分析单细胞 ATAC 或构建共识峰时。

say.text: 用 geniml 从这些 BED 文件构建共识峰（universe）并评估质量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies geniml workflows to ML tasks on BED/genomic intervals: validates inputs, writes executable steps for Region2Vec/scEmbed/BEDspace, and helps build and evaluate peak universes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task involves ML on genomic interval data such as BED files, e.g., training region embeddings, single-cell ATAC analysis, or consensus peak universe building.

say_en.text: Tokenize these BED files and train a Region2Vec model with geniml.
Run scEmbed on this scATAC-seq data with geniml and cluster the cells.
Build a consensus universe from these BED files with geniml and evaluate it.
